title: SimplePractice Session Session Fee Leaderboard
dataSources: SimplePractice therapy sessions (`simplepractice:session`), Headway appointments (`headway:appointment`), BetterHelp sessions (`betterhelp:session`), CBT homework logs (`cbt:homework`), and Daylio mood entries (`daylio:mood`).
app: SimplePractice session notes, Headway appointment confirmations, BetterHelp messaging sessions, CBT homework trackers, and Daylio mood exports ingested into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=simplepractice:session session_fee_usd=*
| stats sum(session_fee_usd) as total_value, avg(session_fee_usd) as avg_value by therapist_name
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks therapist values by total and average session fee across SimplePractice therapy session events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `session_fee_usd` values for each SimplePractice therapy session event and review total and average session fee by therapist.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total session fee.
grandmaExplanation: It compares which therapist shows the biggest session fee numbers in your SimplePractice therapy session data.
